start_server.description: If true, start the JACK audio server immediately when qjackctl launches (corresponds to --start).

server_name.description: The default name for the JACK audio server instance (corresponds to --server-name).

preset_name.description: The name of the saved preset to load on startup (corresponds to --preset). Empty uses defaults.

active_patchbay.description: The filename or path of the active patchbay definition file to load (corresponds to --active-patchbay). Empty loads default or last.

enable_dbus.description: Enable the D-Bus interface to allow external applications to control JACK via qjackctl.

patchbay_path.description: Explicit path to the patchbay definition file.

font.description: Qt font description string for the application interface.

max_messages.description: Maximum number of status messages to retain in the log buffer.

message_time_limit.description: Time in seconds to keep messages in the log buffer before expiring them.
